The '''Library of Chandrila''' was a [[Library/Legends|library]] located on<ref name="Kotor33" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[planet]]<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> by [[3963 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the library discovered a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] document that was quickly disposed of by an agent of [[Jedi Master]] [[Krynda Draay]].<ref name="Kotor33" />
